purpose.zh: 90/90 坐姿后腿主动抬起，练髋内旋主动控制
purpose.en: Practise active internal rotation of the rear hip in a supported ninety-ninety sitting position.

text.zh: 后腿膝盖保持贴垫，慢慢抬起左脚和小腿，再放下
text.en: Keep the rear knee on the mat, slowly lift your left foot and shin, then lower them

text.zh: 右腿在前、左腿在后摆成90/90，躯干保持稳定
text.en: Set the right leg in front and left leg behind in ninety-ninety sitting, keeping the trunk steady.

text.zh: 从左髋主动转动，不用手把脚拉高或抬起膝盖
text.en: Move actively from the left hip without pulling the foot up by hand or lifting the knee.

text.zh: 小幅抬起后缓慢回落，骨盆不翻转
text.en: Use a small controlled lift and lowering without rolling the pelvis.

commonErrors.zh: 把后腿膝盖抬起，变成开髋或整体侧倒
commonErrors.en: Lifting the rear knee into an outward hip opening or leaning the whole body sideways.

commonErrors.zh: 用手扯脚、身体甩动，或向疼痛的内旋终点硬压
commonErrors.en: Pulling the foot with the hand, swinging the trunk or forcing a painful internal-rotation end point.

items.zh: 膝与踝：后膝保持承托，只转动到无痛可控的小幅度，不扭压关节。
items.en: Knees and ankles: keep the rear knee supported and use a small comfortable controlled range without forcing joint rotation.

items.zh: 髋与骨盆：躯干和骨盆稳定，不靠抬膝或侧倒增加高度。
items.en: Hips and pelvis: keep the trunk and pelvis steady rather than lifting the knee or leaning sideways to gain height.

items.zh: 本动作引发疼痛时停止，不通过增加幅度或负重继续；先向医生或物理治疗师确认。
items.en: Stop if this exercise causes pain; do not add range or load before seeking clinical advice.

items.zh: 已有医嘱限制屈膝坐姿、髋内旋或膝踝旋转时，先取得许可。
items.en: Obtain clearance first if bent-knee sitting, hip internal rotation or knee or ankle rotation has been restricted.

definition.countingSemantics: One rear-foot/shin lift and controlled lowering counts as one rep. The left rear knee stays on the mat and the right leg is in front. The 8-second clip has two left-hip reps and no switch. Preserve default 8; proposed per-side interpretation (four loops before changing) requires editorial approval because legacy dose does not explicitly identify per-side versus total. Opposite-side media is not produced.
definition.movementSides: Left foot/shin lifts via rear-hip internal rotation while left knee stays supported; right leg remains in front. Optional boundary after completed per-side dose, not an in-clip or every-loop mandatory switch.
editorialNotes: 显式继承目录已选r2及_9090-feet.mjs脚随小腿修订，另建r3新模型；不回退原版，也不改共用足姿模块。
旧catalog/HipLab主点写后膝抬离地与源相反；新稿明确左后膝固定、后足/小腿抬起。
默认8保持数字，本稿提出每侧8次（左后腿4loops）供编辑审定；旧rhythm.reps=6不得覆盖默认8。h-reverse-clam是旧明确替代和减少90/90坐姿要求的髋内旋目标降阶候选，不是同体位等价。独立同模式进阶未核定。
相位来自catalog/v2/batches/b003.json真实源时间；剂量数字与范围保持旧catalog。rhythm只描述动画，不使用旧reps或holdSeconds来覆盖处方。
具体双语注意、通用禁用筛查、协同肌群与关系均为待审草稿；协同包含稳定/次要拉伸角色，不是额外高亮或肌电激活结论。
关系均为本仓库真实ID候选，不等于已有同模型可发布v2包；不得自动回退弃用模型素材。空关系缺口见逐动作说明。
通用医学筛查证据边界沿用catalog/v2/definition-evidence.md的AAOS/NHS一手资料；不编造疾病特异绝对禁忌，编辑/医学审核均保持pending。
